interviewContext:
improvement: Context:  Ralph Interview Search Budget Specification
 Problem Statement
 During Ralph's interview phase, keywords/topics gathered are used for YouTube video searches. The pipeline enforces:
 - max_total_results: 200 (config.yaml line 91)
 - results_per_keyword: 20 (config.yaml line 90)
 Issue: With 20 results x 10 keywords = 200, any keywords beyond position 10 are never searched. Ralph has no awareness of this limit during interview.
 Requirements
 1. Budget Awareness: Ralph must ingest max_total_results and results_per_keyword from config
 2. Equal Distribution: Search budget distributed evenly across all keywords
 3. Chapter Support: Topics with chapters are split into individual search terms
 4. No Skipped Keywords: All keywords receive at least 1 search attempt
 Functional Specification
 1. Search Budget Calculation
 Current config.yaml settings:
 - video_search.results_per_keyword: 20
 - video_search.max_total_results: 200
 Ralph calculates: max_keywords = floor(200 / 20) = 10 keywords maximum at full rate
 2. Dynamic Budget Adjustment
 When keywords > max_keywords:
 adjusted_results_per_keyword = floor(max_total_results / keyword_count)
 Examples:
 - 5 keywords -> 20 results each -> 100 total
 - 10 keywords -> 20 results each -> 200 total
 - 15 keywords -> 13 results each -> 195 total
 - 20 keywords -> 10 results each -> 200 total
 - 25 keywords -> 8 results each -> 200 total
 3. Chapter Extraction
 Topics containing chapter patterns are split:
 - "Feature: Part 1, Part 2, Part 3" -> 3 keywords
 - "API: Auth, Rate Limit, Retry" -> 3 keywords
 4. Interview UI Display
 Focus Area Selection:
 [1] download (estimated: 20 results)
 [2] quality (estimated: 20 results)
 [3] matching (estimated: 20 results)
 ...
 Budget: 200 max | 12 keywords = 15 results each
 Warning: Add more keywords to maximize coverage
 Implementation
 Functions to Add:
 Get-SearchBudgetInfo (lib/interview.ps1)
 - Reads config.yaml for search limits
 - Returns budget metadata
 Get-DistributedKeywordBudget (lib/interview.ps1)
 - Input: keyword count
 - Output: adjusted results_per_keyword
 Get-ChapterDistributedKeywords (lib/interview.ps1)
 - Input: topic list with chapters
 - Output: flattened keyword array
 Files Modified
 scripts/ralph/lib/interview.ps1 - Add budget functions
 scripts/ralph/interview.ps1 - Add budget display in UI
 Acceptance Criteria
 - Ralph reads max_total_results from config
 - Ralph reads results_per_keyword from config
 - Interview shows budget status
 - Keywords beyond limit get reduced results (not skipped)
 - Chapter patterns detected and split
 - Edge cases handled (0 keywords, 1 keyword, etc.)

Improved Specifications:
Configuration System:
- Existing config sections: broll, core, download, duration, entity, infrastructure, iterative_matching, keywords, llm, matching, media, output, rate_limit
- Ensure new features have corresponding config options
- Follow pattern in src/config/sections/

Pipeline Stages:
- Existing stages: caption
- Review stage dependencies and execution order
- Identify bottlenecks and optimization opportunities

Codebase Analysis:
- Scans completed: 2
- pipeline_stages : findings available
- config_structure : findings available

acceptanceCriteria: Read scripts/ralph/config/ralph-config.json to understand the 'caption' focus area
Read scripts/ralph/session/prompt.md for project context and architecture notes
Read scripts/ralph/state/queue.json for interview details (story outline, architecture decisions, key files)
Read CLAUDE.md for project conventions and known issues
Analyze the codebase to find 8-12 specific improvements for 'caption'
Add stories US-90-002 through US-90-012 to scripts/ralph/state/prd.json (MUST use sprint-prefixed IDs)
Each story MUST have 4-6 testable acceptance criteria
Each story MUST have a 'notes' field with: (1) tier classification, (2) exact source file paths, (3) line number ranges if removing/moving code
IMPORTANT: All generated stories MUST have passes set to false - do NOT run tests or evaluate whether they already pass
IMPORTANT: Story IDs MUST follow format US-90-NNN to be unique across sprints
Mark this story (US-90-001) as passes: true when done
userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for caption focus area
userStories.notes: Tier: seed (generates work items). Focus area: caption. Related files: src/caption_fetcher.py, src/stages/caption_stage.py, src/caption/*.py, config.yaml lines 1129-1300.

acceptanceCriteria: CaptionFetcher.fetch_captions() returns CaptionResult with quality field populated
determine_caption_quality() correctly classifies 'high', 'medium', 'low' quality
Quality classification accounts for auto_generated flag, segment_count, and total_duration
Config option caption_quality_adjustment_enabled controls whether quality affects matching scores
userStories.title: Enhance caption quality detection with completeness scoring
userStories.notes: All 4 criteria verified via tests: TestCaptionResult (35 tests), TestDetermineCaptionQuality (7 tests), TestApplyCaptionQualityAdjustment (14 tests including test_disabled_via_config). Config option wired in scoring.py:362 and :433.

acceptanceCriteria: Negative cache TTL is configurable per error category
Cache entries for 'unavailable' status use unavailable_ttl setting
Cache entries for 'error' status use error_ttl setting
Expired negative cache entries are correctly re-fetched
userStories.title: Improve negative cache TTL configuration for caption unavailability
userStories.notes: All 4 criteria verified: Added unavailable_ttl_seconds (default 3600s) and error_ttl_seconds (default 300s) to config.yaml and CaptionFirstConfig. Implemented store_error() method in CaptionCache. Updated is_negative_entry_stale() to use per-category TTL based on format_source. Backward compatible with legacy negative_cache_ttl_seconds setting.

acceptanceCriteria: CaptionCircuitBreaker tracks consecutive failures per format type
Circuit opens after consecutive_failures threshold is reached
Circuit transitions from closed -> open -> half-open based on reset_timeout
When circuit is open, caption fetches are fast-failed without network call
userStories.title: Add per-format circuit breaker for caption fetching
userStories.notes: All 4 criteria verified: Added CaptionFormatType (youtube, transcript, live_subtitle) to circuit_breaker.py. Per-format state tracked in CaptionCircuitBreakerState.format_states dict. Added check_and_wait_for_format(), record_success_for_format(), record_failure_for_format(), is_format_open(), get_format_stats() methods. get_stats() now includes format_stats. to_checkpoint_dict/from_checkpoint_dict serialize per-format state.

acceptanceCriteria: Pre-check availability uses --list-subs instead of full caption download
Videos without captions are skipped without full fetch attempt
pre_check_availability config option enables/disables this feature
Pre-check is cached for subsequent runs
userStories.title: Optimize caption pre-check to use faster --list-subs API
userStories.notes: PRE-IMPLEMENTED: All 4 criteria verified. Pre-check uses --list-subs (caption_fetcher.py:2765). Videos without captions skipped (line 4867). Config option exists (config.yaml:1188, CaptionFirstConfig:456). Caching via ListSubsCache class (cache.py:1190).

acceptanceCriteria: BatchRetryBudget tracks attempts across entire video batch
Budget auto-scales based on batch size (attempts_per_video scaling)
Budget respects max_backoff_time_seconds cumulative limit
Budget exhaustion triggers fallback to transcription
userStories.title: Improve caption retry budget auto-scaling logic
userStories.notes: FIXED: Added edge case handling in src/caption/retry_budget.py: (1) batch_size=None/0 now handled - skips scaling; (2) max_attempts=0 (unlimited) now preserved - doesn't incorrectly scale to finite value; (3) attempts_per_video<=0 now uses default 1.0. All 334 caption_retry_budget tests pass.

acceptanceCriteria: CaptionStage correctly populates caption_results dict keyed by video_id
CaptionStage falls back to transcription for videos without captions
needs_transcription list correctly identifies videos requiring transcription
Checkpoint correctly saves and restores caption_results
userStories.title: Verify caption-to-transcription fallback pipeline
userStories.notes: VERIFIED: All 4 acceptance criteria pass. Tests: test_caption_results_keyed_by_video_id, test_caption_failures_populate_transcription_fallback_list, test_caption_stage_restore_flow.py (9 tests). Fixed mock config bug in test_make_mock_config by adding safe getattr for config.pipeline.

acceptanceCriteria: UnifiedCaptionRateLimiter handles per-format rate limits
Rate limit backoff respects format-specific backoff_multiplier
Rate limit state is persisted across pipeline runs
Concurrent fetches respect max_parallel_fetches setting
userStories.title: Add format-specific rate limiting backoff multipliers
userStories.notes: Tier: enhancement. File: src/caption/rate_limiter.py, config.yaml lines 1251-1258. Add configurable backoff multipliers per caption format.

acceptanceCriteria: Caption metrics are exported via PipelineMetricsExporter
Metrics include: fetch_success_rate, avg_fetch_time, cache_hit_rate, format_distribution
Metrics are logged at stage completion
Metrics are included in checkpoint summary
userStories.title: Add comprehensive caption stage metrics tracking
userStories.notes: Tier: observability. File: src/caption/metrics.py, src/stages/caption_stage.py. Add structured metrics for caption fetching performance.

acceptanceCriteria: CaptionCache stores entries with video_id and language as composite key
Cache correctly handles language fallback chain
Cache size is bounded by max_cache_size config
Cache eviction uses LRU policy
userStories.title: Implement LRU eviction policy for caption cache
userStories.notes: Tier: enhancement. File: src/caption/cache.py, src/caption_fetcher_cache.py. Add max_cache_size enforcement with LRU eviction.

acceptanceCriteria: FormatTimeoutPolicy applies timeout per format type
timeout values are configurable per format in config.yaml
Timeout exceptions are correctly categorized and retried
Timeout tracking is reset after successful fetch
userStories.title: Configure per-format timeout policies in caption fetching
userStories.notes: Tier: enhancement. File: src/caption_timeout_manager.py, config.yaml lines 1152-1153. Make timeout configurable per format (youtube, transcript, live_subtitle).

acceptanceCriteria: Test coverage for caption_fetcher module exceeds 80%
Test coverage for caption_stage module exceeds 80%
Tests cover: success case, cache hit, cache miss, timeout, format unavailable, circuit breaker open
Tests use mocking for yt-dlp subprocess calls
userStories.title: Increase caption module test coverage to 80%
userStories.notes: Tier: testing. Files: tests/test_caption*.py, src/caption_fetcher.py, src/stages/caption_stage.py. Current coverage gaps identified in caption module.
